sentences.text:
This is the first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS) for grant of anticipatory bail apprehending his arrest in relation to Crime No.460/2022 at Police Station Berasiya, District Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 120B and 34 of IPC.
2.

As per the prosecution story, accused namely Jitendra Singh Yadav has received the loan of Rs.3,00,000/- from Mahindra & Mahindra Finance Services Ltd. for the tractor and without paid the loan amount, got no dues from the RTO Office and again got the loan from Sriram Finance Co.
Ltd..
On the basis of which, offence has been registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that co- NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42631 2 MCRC-29987-2025 accused Jitendra Yadav has taken loan from Mahindra & Mahindra Finance Services Ltd.
Present applicant was guarantor in that loan.

It is further submitted that there is allegation on the co-accused Jitendra Yadav that he has forged NOC in the name of Mahindra & Mahindra company and on the basis of that forged NOC he again took loan from Shri Ram Finance Company.
In that forged NOC present applicant has no role.
There is no need of custodial interrogation of the applicant.
The conclusion of trial will take considerable time.
In these circumstances, applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of anticipatory bail but fairly submitted that there is no document in the case diary which shows that there is any role of present applicant in preparing forged NOC.
5. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

It is directed that if the applicant is arrested by the police then he shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Authority.

(e) He will further abide by the condition enumerated in sub-section (3) of Section 480 of the Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
